method: stage only page, light, LTR, 960x540; press and hold [data-interaction-trigger] 180ms at its centre, then release (extra steps for menu-submenu-nudge, window-lights, tour-spotlight); sample getAnimations every frame for 900ms; moving = duration over 0ms and keyframes differ on a travel, scale, turn, clip or layout property

runs.reduced: No scale and no sink. The pressed fill and the still inner shade carry the state.
No glow. The hover fill carries the state.
No dip and no sink, every duration of the segment 0s in its own CSS. The pressed fill and the still shade carry the state.
The label and the spinner cross fade over duration.base. The button does not move.
No roll, no shake, no draw: the glyph shows whole and the label fades.
No roll, turn, wipe or shake: CopyButton.css sets its own durations to 0s, so each state shows at once. The status still says the result.
The bubble shows and goes at once, in place.
The end part stays still. The hover color carries the state.
CloseButton.css sets its durations to 0s: the fill shows whole at once; the glyph neither turns nor pinches.
SplitButton.css sets its durations to 0s: the chevron points up at once and does not drop.
FloatingActionButton.css sets its durations to 0s: no lift and no slide. The plus shows as a close mark at once; the label shows at once.
Link.css sets its own durations to 0s: the line shows and goes at once, no press weight, the icon stays still.
No layer and no cross fade. The on fill and the ring change at once.
The thumb jumps to the other side and does not lean, grow or stretch; the track does not dip; the fill shows at once.
The thumb still follows the pointer; on release it lands at once.
The fill and the mark appear and leave at once; the box does not dip.
The dash and the check swap at once.
The fill and the dot appear and leave at once; the circle does not dip.
No lift, no dip and no draw; the border, the fill and the check change at once.
The ring, the border color and the halo show at once (every duration token is 0ms); the glow does not grow.

The viewer fades in and out; the image does not travel.
